# The Problem: Loading Everything Upfront

#### Course: React Beyond Basics

```javascript
1import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
2
3function useFetch(url) {
4  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
5  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
6  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
7  const [refetchKey, setRefetchKey] = useState(0);
8
9  useEffect(function () {
10    async function fetchData() {
11      setIsLoading(true);
12      setError(null);
13      try {
14        const res = await fetch(url);
15        
16        if (!res.ok) {
17          throw new Error("Could not load data. Status: " + res.status);
18        }
19        const json = await res.json();
20        setData(json);
21        setIsLoading(false);
22      } catch (err) {
23        setError(err.message);
24        setIsLoading(false);
25      }
26    }
27    fetchData();
28  }, [url, refetchKey]);
29
30  function refetch() {
31    setRefetchKey(function (k) { return k + 1; });
32  }
33
34  return { data, isLoading, error, refetch };
35}
36
37export default useFetch;
```

```javascript
1import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
2
3function useSearch(entries) {
4  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
5
6  const filteredEntries = useMemo(function () {
7    if (!query.trim()) return entries;
8    const lower = query.toLowerCase();
9    return entries.filter(function (entry) {
10      return (
11        entry.title.toLowerCase().includes(lower) ||
12        entry.content.toLowerCase().includes(lower)
13      );
14    });
15  }, [entries, query]);
16
17  return { query, setQuery, filteredEntries };
18}
19
20export default useSearch;
```

```javascript
1import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
2
3function usePagination(entries, pageSize) {
4  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
5
6  const totalPages = useMemo(function () {
7    return Math.ceil(entries.length / pageSize);
8  }, [entries, pageSize]);
9
10  const pagedEntries = useMemo(function () {
11    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
12    return entries.slice(start, start + pageSize);
13  }, [entries, currentPage, pageSize]);
14
15  function handleNext() {
16    setCurrentPage(function (p) { return Math.min(p + 1, totalPages); });
17  }
18
19  function handlePrev() {
20    setCurrentPage(function (p) { return Math.max(p - 1, 1); });
21  }
22
23  function reset() {
24    setCurrentPage(1);
25  }
26
27  return { currentPage, pagedEntries, totalPages, handleNext, handlePrev, reset };
28}
29
30export default usePagination
```

```undefined
1import { useJournal } from '../context/JournalContext'
2import Header from '../components/Header'
3import EntryCard from '../components/EntryCard'
4import usePagination from '../hooks/usePagination'
5import useSearch from '../hooks/useSearch'
6
7const ENTRIES_PER_PAGE = 5
8
9function HomePage() {
10    const { entries, dispatch, isLoading,refetch, error } = useJournal()
11    const { query, setQuery, filteredEntries } = useSearch(entries)
12
13    const { currentPage, pagedEntries, totalPages, handleNext, handlePrev, reset } = usePagination(
14        filteredEntries,
15        ENTRIES_PER_PAGE );
16
17  function handleQueryChange(newQuery) {
18    setQuery(newQuery)
19    reset()
20  }
21
22  return (
23    <>
24    <Header query={query} onQueryChange={handleQueryChange} />
25    <section className="entries-section">
26      <div className="entry-list-header">
27        <h3>Recent Entries</h3>
28        <span className="entry-count">{filteredEntries.length}</span>
29        {query && <span className="entry-count">{'of ' + entries.length}</span>}
30        <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={refetch}>Refresh</button>
31      </div>
32      {isLoading ? (
33        <p className="loading-state">Loading entries...</p>
34      ) : error ? (
35        <div className="error-banner">
36          <p className="error-label">Something went wrong.</p>
37          <p className="error-detail">{error}</p>
38        </div>
39      ) : pagedEntries.length === 0 ? (
40        <p className="empty-state">No entries found.</p>
41      ) : (
42        pagedEntries.map(function (entry) {
43          return (
44             <EntryCard
45              key={entry.id}
46              id={entry.id}
47              title={entry.title}
48              date={entry.date}
49              content={entry.content}
50              author={entry.author}
51              bookmarked={entry.bookmarked}
52              onBookmark={function () { dispatch({ type: 'BOOKMARK_ENTRY', payload: { id: entry.id } }) }}
53            />
54          )
55        })
56      )}
57      {!isLoading && !error && totalPages > 1 && (
58        <div className="pagination">
59          <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={handlePrev} disabled={currentPage === 1}>Previous</button>
60          <span className="pagination-info">Page {currentPage} of {totalPages}</span>
61          <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={handleNext} disabled={currentPage === totalPages}>Next</button>
62        </div>
63      )}
64    </section>
65    </>
66  )
67}
68
69export default HomePage
```

1import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react'
2
3const ThemeContext = createContext(null)
4
5export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
6  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light')
7
8  useEffect(function () {
9    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme)
10    localStorage.setItem('theme', theme)
11  }, [theme])
12
13  function toggleTheme() {
14    setTheme(function (t) { return t === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light' })
15  }
16
17  return (
18    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggleTheme }}>
19      {children}
20    </ThemeContext.Provider>
21  )
22}
23
24export function useTheme() {
25  return useContext(ThemeContext)
26}

```undefined
1import { createContext, useReducer, useState, useContext, useEffect } from 'react'
2
3const JournalContext = createContext(null)
4const API_URL = 'https://dev.api.programiz.pro/api/Demo/v1/journal-entries'
5
6function journalReducer(state, action) {
7  switch (action.type) {
8    case 'SET_ENTRIES':
9      return action.payload
10    case 'BOOKMARK_ENTRY':
11      return state.map(function (entry) {
12        return entry.id === action.payload.id
13          ? { ...entry, bookmarked: !entry.bookmarked }
14          : entry
15      })
16    default:
17      return state
18  }
19}
20
21function JournalProvider({ children }) {
22  const [entries, dispatch] = useReducer(journalReducer, [])
23  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)
24  const [error, setError] = useState(null)
25  const [refetchKey, setRefetchKey] = useState(0)
26
27  useEffect(function () {
28    async function loadEntries() {
29      setIsLoading(true)
30      setError(null)
31      try {
32        const res = await fetch(API_URL)
33        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Could not load data. Status: ' + res.status)
34        const data = await res.json()
35        const formatted = data.map(function (entry) {
36          return {
37            ...entry,
38            bookmarked: false,
39            date: new Date(entry.date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
40              year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric'
41            }).toUpperCase()
42          }
43        })
44        dispatch({ type: 'SET_ENTRIES', payload: formatted })
45      } catch (err) {
46        setError(err.message)
47      } finally {
48        setIsLoading(false)
49      }
50    }
51    loadEntries()
52  }, [refetchKey])
53
54  function refetch() {
55    setRefetchKey(function (k) { return k + 1 })
56  }
57
58  return (
59    <JournalContext.Provider value={{ entries, dispatch, isLoading, error, refetch }}>
60      {children}
61    </JournalContext.Provider>
62  )
63}
64
65function useJournal() {
66  return useContext(JournalContext)
67}
68
69export { JournalProvider, useJournal }
```

These are static imports. When the app starts, React loads every one of these components immediately, before the user has even found the time to navigate anywhere.

Right now the app is small, so this is fast.

But as pages grow — say, HomePage adds filtering and sorting, EntryDetailPage adds a rich text editor — the bundle grows with them, even for pages the user never visits.

Fixing this issue is what this chapter's all about.

![Why One Bundle Doesn't Scale](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)
